title: Season 1
overview: Blinded as a young boy, Matt Murdock fights injustice by day as a lawyer and by night as the vigilante Daredevil in Hell's Kitchen, New York City, taking on crime boss Wilson Fisk.

episodes.title: Into the Ring
episodes.overview: Murdock and Nelson take the case of a woman accused of murder, while Matt takes to the streets to uncover a human trafficking ring.

episodes.title: Cut Man
episodes.overview: Near death, Daredevil is found by a nurse who aids his recovery, while he reflects on his father and vows to save a kidnapped boy.

episodes.title: Rabbit in a Snowstorm
episodes.overview: Nelson and Murdock are offered a high-paying client by a mysterious associate of Wilson Fisk, testing their ethics.

episodes.title: In the Blood
episodes.overview: Wilson Fisk seeks to strengthen his romantic relationship with art dealer Vanessa Marianna while expanding his criminal syndicate.

episodes.title: World on Fire
episodes.overview: Fisk orchestrates coordinated bombings targeting the Russian mob across Hell's Kitchen, shaking the city.

episodes.title: Condemned
episodes.overview: Trapped in an abandoned warehouse with an injured Vladimir, Daredevil faces corrupt SWAT officers and Fisk's media manipulation.

episodes.title: Stick
episodes.overview: Matt's harsh childhood martial arts mentor Stick returns to Hell's Kitchen, hunting a dangerous weapon known as Black Sky.

episodes.title: Shadows in the Glass
episodes.overview: Murdock and Ben Urich prepare to expose Fisk, while Fisk confronts his traumatic childhood and makes a shocking public appearance.

episodes.title: Speak of the Devil
episodes.overview: Matt faces Nobu in brutal combat and survives an ambush by Fisk, returning gravely wounded to his apartment where Foggy discovers his identity.

episodes.title: Nelson v. Murdock
episodes.overview: Foggy confronts Matt about his secret vigilantism, leading to the fracture of their friendship and law partnership.

episodes.title: The Path of the Righteous
episodes.overview: Matt recovers and seeks specialized armor from Melvin Potter, while Fisk mourns the poisoning of Vanessa.

episodes.title: The Ones We Leave Behind
episodes.overview: Fisk retaliates against Ben Urich for investigating his mother, while Madame Gao burns her heroin distribution facility.

episodes.title: Daredevil
episodes.overview: Donning his iconic red armor and dual batons, Daredevil corners and defeats Wilson Fisk in an alley brawl, sending him to prison.

verification.notes: Confirmed Season 1 of Daredevil. 13 episodes released simultaneously on Netflix on April 10, 2015.
